TLS 1.2 / 1.3 保护 SIP 信令，SRTP 保护语音媒体。支持分机: TLS 1.2 / 1.3 protects SIP signaling; SRTP protects voice media. Individual extension passwords and Digest authentication are supported.
基于 Tokio 异步运行时，以内存安全、无 GC 的 Rust 构建最小化 S: A minimal SIP server built with memory-safe Rust and the Tokio async runtime, without garbage collection.
在自己的 VPS 上部署，管理内部分机。支持语音通话与 SIP 文本消息、离线暂: Deploy on your own VPS and manage internal extensions. Make voice calls and send SIP text messages, with temporary offline queuing and redelivery.
关于加密：媒体在服务器中继时解密后重新加密，服务器属于信任边界；并非端到端加密。: Encryption note: the server decrypts and re-encrypts relayed media, so it is part of the trust boundary. This is not end-to-end encryption. Offline messages are held in memory and lost on restart.

鸣鹤可以部署在 Vercel 上吗？: Can I deploy MingHe on Vercel?
本介绍网站可以直接部署到 Vercel。鸣鹤 SIP 服务器需要固定 TCP 信: This website can be deployed directly to Vercel. The MingHe SIP server needs a fixed TCP signaling port and a fixed UDP media port range. Use a suitable VPS or your own server.
项目文档推荐 Bria Mobile 和 Linkvil W610W / W62: The project recommends Bria Mobile and Linkvil W610W / W620W. Other clients need SIP over TLS, SDES-SRTP, and appropriate certificate trust settings. These capabilities need separate verification for the Tantuns H5.
自签名证书要如何配置？: How do I use a self-signed certificate?
将服务器的 certs/server.crt 导入客户端为受信任证书，并保持证书: Import certs/server.crt from your server as a trusted certificate in your client and keep certificate verification enabled. Update client trust after renewal. For public deployments, use a certificate from a trusted CA.
